scene_assessment.description: Current task stage, visible ball/gripper and basket interior relation; cite current camera roles. Holding may be unknown. Use one or two short sentences; unknown is allowed.

previous_result_assessment.description: Compare proposal with actual commands, SDK and measured motion. Object change and failure time are unknown without paired images or reliable historical object evidence. Use one or two short sentences; unknown is allowed.

next_action_intent.description: Intended relationship change and a brief evidence-based reason. Use one or two short sentences; unknown is allowed.

expected_visible_change.description: Observable change to check at the next observation; a prediction, not a fact. Use one or two short sentences; unknown is allowed.

translation_m.description: Componentwise delta in the current work frame, metres.

rotation_rpy_rad.description: Componentwise increment to current RPY, radians; same existing executor semantics.

gripper_opening.description: Desired opening target: 0=fully closed, 1=fully open. Not force control.

done.description: Terminal completion. No actuator commands are sent when true; opening target is ignored and arm delta must be zero.
